companions.name: S2
companions.description: A hot young star on a 16-year orbit around Sagittarius A*, the Milky Way's central black hole.

radius.source: Habibi et al. (2017), ApJ 847, 120, Table 3: 5.53 (+1.77/-0.79) solar radii, model-atmosphere fit to SINFONI spectra

mass.source: Habibi et al. (2017), ApJ 847, 120, Table 3: 13.60 (+2.2/-1.8) solar masses

text.card: A hot young star that swings around the Milky Way's central black hole every 16 years.
text.introduction: At its closest, in 2018, it passed 120 au from Sagittarius A*, four times Neptune's distance from the Sun.

companions.colorReason: S2 is observed only in the near-infrared (the SINFONI H- and K-band spectra of Habibi et al. 2017); no spectrum of it covers visible light
